questions.problem: Which of the following is equivalent to $(3x+4)({x}^{2}-6x-9)?$
questions.worked_solution:
We distribute both terms of the binomial in the first set of parentheses to the trinomial in the second set of parentheses. Then, we simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}(3x+4)({x}^{2}-6x-9) & = \\ 3x({x}^{2}-6x-9)+4({x}^{2}-6x-9) & = \\ 3{x}^{3}-18{x}^{2}-27x+4{x}^{2}-24x-36 & = \\ 3{x}^{3}-14{x}^{2}-51x-36\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem: What is the coefficient of $zx$ in the product $(2x-y+2z)(y+2x)?$
questions.worked_solution:
We distribute the terms of the trinomial in the first set of parentheses to the binomial in the second set of parentheses. Then, we simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}(2x-y+2z)(y+2x) & = \\ 2x(y+2x)+(-y)(y+2x)+2z(y+2x) & = \\ 2xy+4{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}-2xy+2zy+4zx & = \\ 4{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}+2zy+4zx\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,  the coefficient of $zx$ is $4.$

questions.problem: What is the coefficient of $v{w}^{2}$ in the product $(v+w)({v}^{2}+4vw+{w}^{2})?$
questions.worked_solution:
We distribute both terms of the binomial in the first set of parentheses to the trinomial in the second set of parentheses. Then, we simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}(v+w)({v}^{2}+4vw+{w}^{2}) & = \\ v({v}^{2}+4vw+{w}^{2})+w({v}^{2}+4vw+{w}^{2}) & = \\ {v}^{3}+4{v}^{2}w+v{w}^{2}+{v}^{2}w+4v{w}^{2}+{w}^{3} & = \\ {v}^{3}+5{v}^{2}w+5v{w}^{2}+{w}^{3} & \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coefficient of $v{w}^{2}$ is $5.$

canonical_examples.worked_solution:
We distribute both terms of the binomial to the trinomial in the second parenthesis. Then, we simplify.

$$

		(x - 3)(x^2 - 2x + 6) &= \
		x(x^2 - 2x + 6) - 3(x^2 - 2x + 6) &= \
		x^3 - 2x^2 + 6x - 3x^2 + 6x - 18 &= \
		x^3 - 5x^2 + 12x - 18
	}
$$

canonical_examples.worked_solution:

$$

$$

Matching up the coefficients, we find that $a=5,$ $b=7,$ and $c=3.$

So, we have

$$
a + b + c = 5 + 7 + 3 = 15.
$$

canonical_examples.problem: What is the coefficient of $a^2b$ in the product $(a+b)(a^2 + ab + b^2)?$
canonical_examples.worked_solution:
We distribute both terms of the binomial in the first set of parentheses to the trinomial in the second set of parentheses. Then, we simplify.

$$
\begin{aligned}(a+b)({a}^{2}+ab+{b}^{2}) & = \\ a({a}^{2}+ab+{b}^{2})+b({a}^{2}+ab+{b}^{2}) & = \\ {a}^{3}+{a}^{2}b+a{b}^{2}+{a}^{2}b+a{b}^{2}+{b}^{3} & = \\ {a}^{3}+2{a}^{2}b+2a{b}^{2}+{b}^{3} & \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coefficient of $a^2 b$ is $2.$

tutorials.name: Introduction
tutorials.problem:
To multiply a binomial and a trinomial, we take each term of the binomial and multiply it by every term in the trinomial. Then, we simplify by collecting like terms.

For example, to multiply $({\color{blue}{x}} + {\color{red}{3}})$ and $(x^2 + 2x+4),$ we multiply ${\color{blue}{x}}$ and $(x^2 + 2x+4),$ and then we add this to the product of ${\color{red}{3}}$ and $(x^2 + 2x+4).$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}(x+3)({x}^{2}+2x+4) & = \\ x({x}^{2}+2x+4)+3({x}^{2}+2x+4) & = \\ {x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+4x+3{x}^{2}+6x+12\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we group the like terms and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+4x+3{x}^{2}+6x+12 & = \\ {x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+3{x}^{2}+4x+6x+12 & = \\ {x}^{3}+5{x}^{2}+10x+12\end{aligned}
$$
